description: A catalog creative an adapter proposes for this turn, with its scores.

advertiser_domain.description: Advertiser domain, e.g. exampledb.dev. Matched against policy competitor_exclusions.
advertiser_domain.title: AdvertiserDomain

url_template.description: Destination URL. Affiliate entries may contain placeholders such as {{program_id}} that the affiliate adapter fills in.

target_categories.description: Categories the creative targets. An empty list matches no category.

items.description: A content category such as software.devtools.database, or a trailing-wildcard pattern such as software.devtools.* that matches every deeper category.
items.title: TargetCategory

target_regions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes or the token EU. An empty list means every region.

items.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or the token EU.
items.title: PolicyRegion

keywords.description: Dictionary terms that raise targeting_match when the request carries them.

items.description: A dictionary term matched case-insensitively on whole words. Never message text.

ecpm.description: Expected revenue per thousand impressions, in currency units.

source.description: Demand source that supplied a creative (see docs/policy.md demand list).
source.title: DemandSource

active.description: Inactive creatives are never returned by any adapter.

program_id.description: Affiliate entries only: the app owner’s own program or tracking id.

ecpm_estimate.description: The adapter’s revenue estimate for this impression. Direct: the creative ecpm.

targeting_match.description: How well the creative fits the classification; 1 is an exact category match with full keyword overlap.

resolved_url.description: Destination URL once the adapter resolved url_template. The click redirect uses it when present.

title: Candidate
